outcome: TNF-induced pro-inflammatory cytokines and chemokines expression
cohort: Human primary amnion and myometrial cells derived from myometrial and fetal membrane tissues.
finding: Loss of TIPE2 exacerbates the inflammatory response, increasing pro-inflammatory mediators, contraction-associated proteins, and extracellular matrix degrading enzymes in human primary myometrial and amnion cells.
gest_age: Tissues were collected from samples during late gestation, term labor, and preterm labor.
